q1_repeat_categories.answer: Users repeatedly buy from the same categories due to convenience, habit, and the availability of preferred products.

q2_exploration_blockers.answer: High prices, poor product quality, and difficulties with customer support prevent users from exploring new categories.

q3_discovery_channels.answer: Users primarily discover products through the app itself, with some instances of word-of-mouth and search.

q4_habit_role.answer: Habits play a significant role in shopping behavior, with many users relying on the app for quick, daily essentials and groceries.

q5_info_needed.answer: Users need information about product quality, pricing, and availability before trying a new category.

q6_recurring_frustrations.answer: Recurring frustrations include poor product quality, high prices, and difficulties with customer support and delivery.

q7_experimenting_segments.answer: The 'explorer' segment, which accounts for 25 users, is more likely to experiment with new categories and products.

q8_unmet_needs.answer: Unmet needs include better product quality, more competitive pricing, and improved customer support, particularly for categories like electronics accessories and baby care.
